name: 4-Across
subtitle: Press break against a zone press
goal: Beat the press with passes, not dribbles. Catch it and look up.
options: First: 1 up the sideline for the fast break. Backup, always there: back to 3, then reverse to 4.

steps.note: 3 fakes a pass to the middle, then hits 5. If 5 is covered, look to 4, then 1. Ball to 4 is the same pattern on the other side.

On the catch: 1 angle-cuts to the sideline at half court. 2 angle-cuts to the right side of the center circle. 4 comes up to the first sideline mark and stays back for the reversal. 3 steps in behind the ball as the safety.
First look: 1 up the sideline for the fast break. The defense will start taking this away.
The backup is always there: 5 passes back to 3.
3 reverses the ball to 4 on the other side.
